items.title: Situational Awareness AI Hedge Fund Probed by SEC After Near Implosion
items.summary: Situational Awareness, a prominent AI hedge fund that recently faced near collapse, is now under investigation by the SEC, highlighting growing regulatory scrutiny in the AI finance sector.

items.title: Salesforce Launches New Slackbot AI Agent to Compete in Workplace AI Market
items.summary: Salesforce has introduced a new Slackbot AI agent, intensifying its competition with tech giants Microsoft and Google in the rapidly expanding workplace AI solutions market.

items.title: OpenAI Enhances GPT-5.6 in Kiro for Improved Developer Price-Performance
items.summary: OpenAI announces advancements to its GPT-5.6 model within the Kiro platform, focusing on optimizing price-performance for developers building AI applications.

items.title: Listen Labs Secures $69M to Scale AI Customer Interviews After Viral Stunt
items.summary: Listen Labs has raised $69 million in funding, following a viral billboard hiring campaign, to expand its AI-powered platform for conducting customer interviews at scale.

items.title: Compute-Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts Models
items.summary: New research proposes a compute-efficient method for hyperparameter transfer, significantly improving the training process for large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models.

items.title: Graph Engineering for LLM Agents: Advancing from Individual to System Intelligence
items.summary: A paper explores the critical role of graph engineering in developing advanced LLM agents, shifting focus from individual agent intelligence to more complex system-level intelligence.

items.title: InfinityEdit: Infinite Video Editing with a Lightweight Edit-Ignition Adapter
items.summary: Researchers introduce InfinityEdit, a novel system enabling infinite video editing capabilities through a lightweight 'edit-ignition' adapter, promising new possibilities for creative content generation.

items.title: Google Sheets Canvas Brings AI-Powered Features to Spreadsheet Data
items.summary: Google rolls out 'Sheets canvas' for Google Sheets, integrating new AI capabilities to help users visualize and interact with their spreadsheet data more dynamically.

items.title: Your Agent Doesn't Have a Reasoning Problem, It Has a Memory Problem
items.summary: An article argues that many issues with AI agent performance stem from inadequate memory management rather than fundamental reasoning flaws, suggesting new directions for agent development.

items.title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence for LLMs
items.summary: A new research paper introduces ParaTempo, a method for achieving efficient parallel reasoning in large language models by leveraging temporal confidence mechanisms.

items.title: OmniAssistBench: A New Benchmark for Assistant-Style Interaction in Omni-LLMs
items.summary: Researchers present OmniAssistBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate and improve assistant-style interaction capabilities across various Omni-LLMs.

items.title: The Tests Passed. The Contract Was Wrong: AI in Software Development
items.summary: This piece explores a critical challenge in AI-assisted software development where tests might pass, but the underlying contract or specification generated by AI is fundamentally flawed.

items.title: Beyond Correctness: Benchmarking and Aligning Response Behaviors in Hybrid-Thinking MLLMs
items.summary: New research emphasizes the need to benchmark and align not just correctness but also the behavioral aspects of responses from Hybrid-Thinking Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).

items.title: I Almost Shipped a RAG Assistant That Lied About APIs That Don't Exist
items.summary: A developer shares a cautionary tale about nearly deploying a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant that hallucinated non-existent APIs, highlighting practical challenges in AI agent development.

items.title: I Tried to Prompt-Inject My Own Agent Engine. It Didn't Work. Here's Why.
items.summary: An engineer recounts an attempt to prompt-inject their own AI agent engine and explains the underlying security and robustness mechanisms that prevented the attack from succeeding.
